dedupe_keys.name: raw opc ua dataset of a working industry 4 0 smart factory h da autfab

description: Lukas Kaupp and collaborators publish aligned OPC-UA observations from the Darmstadt AutFab learning factory. The public Zenodo ZIP is labelled CC BY-NC 4.0, but the description additionally says usage must be requested; that access condition is retained. Five successful assemblies were recorded on 13 March 2019. The provider reports 17,464 node columns and 11,455 time rows, with only 1,022 columns changing more than once. These multivariate traces can benchmark state reconstruction and normal-operation components in manufacturing simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this raw session. It contains no documented anomalies, so it cannot independently validate failure detection. The archive name explicitly states that node descriptions are absent, limiting physical interpretation and transfer. Timing precision and node-to-asset mapping remain unknown. No usage request was sent, archive downloaded or industrial-control performance inferred.
